1594-2363-4659-5224.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Helm of Awakening, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

483-1339-1832-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
483-1339-1832-2034.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1339-3967-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-3967-4616.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4549-4556--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4435-4550-5567-8095--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4435-4550-5567-8095--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5075-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Ogre Slumlord, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

341-661-3685-4659.description:
Cast Sculpting Steel by paying {2} due to Umori. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Spine of Ish Sah.
When Sculpting Steel enters, its first ability triggers, destroying a permanent.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sculpting Steel, adding {C}{C}.
Sculpting Steel's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1453-1477-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-1477-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1486-3459-7176--68.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Battered Golem to gain all creature types.
Activate the creature with saddle's saddle ability by tapping Battered Golem.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Resolve the saddle ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1483-5147-6972--112.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
1483-5147-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1778-4053-5686-6989.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2933-4013-5798-6965.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

570-1978-5056.description:
Cause Faeburrow Elder to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat from step 2.

969-2034-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2438-3781-4215--124.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-3781-4215--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

1181-1869-2171-2493.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Persist by paying {1}{B}, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Inalla.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste.
The token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Persist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Archaeomancer tokens, if Inalla is on the battlefield, you may activate Inalla's ability infinite times to cause infinite lifeloss for opponents.

856-2292-4321-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2292-4321-5631.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

509-625-1267-4883.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-625-1267-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-625-1267-4883.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Transmogrant by tapping and sacrificing it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

1636-2438-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1636-2438-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist.

3388-4050--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost, adding one mana of any color.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Repeat.

4050-4242-4790-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
4050-4242-4790-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA's second ability by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Su-Chi token dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

147-997-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

396-560-1409-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
396-560-1409-4050.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and another creature you control.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorn and Soldier, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

152-3263-4497-4853.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nonlegendary creature with mana value eight or greater.
Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
152-3263-4497-4853.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary artifact with mana value eight or greater.
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact creature token, adding at least eight {R} that can only be spent to activate abilities of artifacts or to cast artifact spells.
The artifact creature token dies, triggering Dross Scorpion, untapping Slobad.
Repeat.

1636-2068-4283.notablePrerequisites:
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional nontoken creatures.
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
1636-2068-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures you control, targeting any creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting another creature card in your graveyard.
Resolve the first Whisper ability, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

2160-2697-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2160-2697-3976.description:
Cast Last Chance by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Last Chance and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creature that has Last Chance noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Last Chance without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Last Chance trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

618-864-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness with haste.
The token copy of Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2103-4270-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
2103-4270-4423.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Capture of Jingzhou on top of your library.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
